'''Leland Simmons''' (also published as '''Leeland Simmons''') is a Star Wars CCG player from Texas. He finished 17th at [[2000 Texas State Championship]] on 6 May 2000, according to Brian Guthrie's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d692">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-08-tx-state-championship-director-s-reportd692/ tx-state-championship-director-s-report], DeckTech (Brian "Red 81" Guthrie, 8 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-08-tx-state-championship-director-s-reportd692/ GitHub Pages].</ref> He played M&T with heavy SAC at the [[2000 Houston Grand Slam]] on 8 July 2000, according to Justin Warren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d988" />
